DINOv2 (small) — image preprocessor configuration
=================================================

Vendored file: dinov2-small-preprocessor_config.json
SHA-256:       14e780d86fa1861f8751f868d7f45425b5feb55c38ca26f152ca5097ab30f828

Source
------
Kaggle Model `metaresearch/dinov2`, framework PyTorch, variation `small`,
version 1 — the exact artifact the preflight kernel mounts offline. Retrieved
read-only via `kaggle models instances versions download`. Mounted files are
dated 2023-08-08.

Licence
-------
The model card for that pinned artifact declares:

    license: cc-by-nc-4.0

i.e. Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International.
See https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/

This corrects an earlier record. `docs/collaboration/active_task.md` rounds
37-38 and an earlier revision of the Phase 3B specification recorded this
model as Apache-2.0; the model card for the pinned version does not. Meta
relicensed DINOv2 upstream after this artifact was published, so the upstream
repository and this 2023-vintage mirror may differ — but the licence that
governs this project is the one on the artifact the kernel actually mounts,
which is the one quoted above. Recorded in round 86 and accepted by the user
under the competition rule "Freely & publicly available external data/
pretrained models allowed" (`docs/1_instructions.md`).

Only this metadata file is vendored. No model weights are redistributed here;
they are mounted at run time from the Kaggle Model source.
